name: Sofia Vargas Mendoza
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a local karting event in Lima. Captivated by the vibrant liveries and meticulous paintwork, she secured an apprenticeship at a small body shop specializing in automotive restoration. There, she honed her skills, mastering color matching and application techniques.

Driven by a desire to apply her expertise to high-performance vehicles, Sofia joined Trident Racing as a paint shop specialist. She approaches each project with meticulous precision, ensuring every surface is flawlessly prepared and coated. Her demanding nature pushes her team to achieve the highest standards of quality, recognizing that the paintwork is not just cosmetic but also contributes to aerodynamic efficiency and brand image.

Sofia’s methodical approach and unwavering attention to detail set her apart. She's renowned for her ability to identify subtle imperfections invisible to the untrained eye, ensuring that every car leaving her shop is a testament to her dedication and skill.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical braid.
physical.description: Sofia is of average height, with a focused gaze and hands calloused from years of skilled work.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass to inspect paint finishes.
Insists on using only natural light when color matching.
Has a collection of vintage automotive paint samples.
